# ChinaEaseBuddy - China Travel Guide for Foreigners

ChinaEaseBuddy helps foreign travelers navigate China without a Chinese national ID.

Guides are reviewed periodically and written for foreign visitors, including travelers who do not have a Chinese national ID.

## Primary guides

- Payment for foreigners: [https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-payment-guide/](https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-payment-guide/)
- SIM Card and eSIM for foreigners: [https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-sim-card-for-foreigners/](https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-sim-card-for-foreigners/)
- Travel checklist: [https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-travel-checklist/](https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-travel-checklist/)
- Airport arrival: [https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-airport-arrival-guide/](https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-airport-arrival-guide/)
- Travel apps: [https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-travel-apps/](https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-travel-apps/)
- 240-hour visa-free transit: [https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-240-hour-visa-free-transit-2026/](https://chinaeasebuddy.com/china-240-hour-visa-free-transit-2026/)
